units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 2:1:6">Y. Erub. II, 20ᵃ</cite> <he>בהן דעֵגְלִין</he> in the case of those stones which are round (forming a fence).
<cite ref="Menachot 94b:4">Men. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>דעַגֵּיל להו מִיעַגֵּל</he> he rounded them off.

senses.gloss: to twine around. Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ [read:] נסב פסקיא דעמר ועַגְּלָהּ וכ׳ (v. פְּסִיקְיָא) he took a woolen band and wound it around both of them.
